data.title: E1: money questions at the end of the Probe B interview script
data.description: Add Q-M1..Q-M3 from monetization-discovery §6 after the core script, never before it (DEC-17, counter-metric 'we named it first' = 0). Pre-set pass marks: >= 2 of 5 give a dated cross-repo story with a cost; Q-M3 split decides App vs Action. Mirror into the outreach call guide in kadence-outreach.
